quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: What began as a modest experiment in time-blocking her calendar has, over the better part of a year, evolved into something closer to a personal operating system for Renata, one in which even leisure activities are scheduled with the same deliberateness as work obligations, a practice she initially resisted as overly rigid but now credits with eliminating the low-grade anxiety she used to feel about unstructured time. Colleagues who have adopted a looser version of her system report more modest, though still noticeable, benefits.
quests.question: Renata initially resisted her time-blocking system as overly rigid.
quests.hint: Check how Renata felt about the system when she first started.
quests.explanation: The passage confirms she initially resisted it as overly rigid, so this is true.
